title: Restriction triangle has cone supported on the closed complement
statement: Let Y be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let V be a quasi-compact open subscheme with open immersion j:V \to Y, and let K be an object of D_QCoh(Y) [def-pc-derived-category]. Then there is a distinguished triangle K \to Rj_*Lj^*K \to Q \to K[1] in D_QCoh(Y) [def-pc-derived-direct-image], where all cohomology sheaves of Q are supported on Y\setminus V. If K belongs to D_QCoh^+(Y), then Q belongs to D_QCoh^+(Y).

source.place: Tag 0E4G (Lemma 48.4.3), proof; Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemmas 36.4.1 and Definition 36.6.1

proof.text: Choose a K-injective representative I of K. Restriction to V preserves K-injectivity by [lem-sc-derived-k-injective-restrict-open], so Lj^*K is represented by j^{-1}I. By [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image], Rj_*Lj^*K is represented by j_*j^{-1}I. The derived direct-image preservation theorem [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-preserves-qcoh] applies because j is quasi-compact (V is quasi-compact) and Y is quasi-separated, and j^{-1} preserves quasi-coherence on an open subscheme. The adjunction unit is represented by I \to j_*j^{-1}I. Complete it to its mapping-cone triangle; by [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] this gives K \to Rj_*Lj^*K \to Q \to K[1]. The cone cohomology sheaves are quasi-coherent: the long exact cohomology sequence expresses each as an extension of a kernel and a cokernel, and quasi-coherent modules are closed under these operations by [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-kernel], [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-cokernel-image], and [lem-pc-quasi-coherent-extension]. Thus Q is in D_QCoh(Y).

source.place: Tag 0E4G (Lemma 48.4.3), proof, first paragraph; Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.4.1

proof.text: Applying Lj^* to this triangle gives Lj^*K \to Lj^*Rj_*Lj^*K \to Lj^*Q \to Lj^*K[1]. Exactness of underived restriction, supplied by [lem-sc-derived-open-restriction-adjunction-exact], identifies Lj^* with termwise j^{-1}, so this is the image of the cone triangle of j^{-1}I \to j^{-1}j_*j^{-1}I. The open restriction compatibility [lem-pc-restrict-derived-direct-image-open], applied to f=j, U=V, and g=\operatorname{id}_V, identifies Lj^*Rj_*Lj^*K with Lj^*K. Concretely, on the representatives the first arrow is an isomorphism already at the level of complexes: for an open W\subseteq V one has (j_*j^{-1}I)(W)=I(j^{-1}W)=I(W), so j^{-1}j_*j^{-1}I=j^{-1}I and the restricted unit j^{-1}I\to j^{-1}j_*j^{-1}I is the identity (Stacks Tag 01LH). Hence Lj^*Q, the cone of an isomorphism, is 0. The cohomology long exact sequence gives j^{-1}H^n(Q)=0 for every n, which is exactly that every cohomology sheaf of Q is supported on the closed complement Y\setminus V.

source.place: Tag 0E4G (Lemma 48.4.3), proof; Derived Categories of Schemes, Definition 36.6.1

proof.text: If K is in D_QCoh^+(Y), with H^n(K)=0 for n<a, replace K by its truncation \tau_{\ge a}K, a quasi-isomorphic complex with terms zero below a. The category of \mathcal O_Y-modules has enough injectives (Stacks Tag 01DH), so [lem-sc-bounded-below-injective-resolution-existence] gives a quasi-isomorphism to a bounded-below complex I of injective \mathcal O_Y-modules with I^n=0 for n<a; such I is K-injective by [lem-weil-pbc-bounded-below-injectives-kinjective], so it may serve as the representative I of Step 1. Then j^{-1}I is termwise zero below a and K-injective (Step 1), and [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image] represents Rj_*Lj^*K by j_*j^{-1}I, which is zero in every degree below a because direct image is applied termwise. The mapping cone of I \to j_*j^{-1}I from Step 1 has terms (j_*j^{-1}I)^n\oplus I^{n+1}, zero for n<a-1, so H^n(Q)=0 for n<a-1. Thus Q belongs to D_QCoh^+(Y).

lean.statement: theorem openRestriction_support_triangle (Y : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y] (V : Y.Opens) (hV : IsCompact (V : Set Y)) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace))] (K : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (hK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y K) : ∃ (adj : (schemeOpenRestriction Y V).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage V.ι) (Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (β : (schemeDerivedDirectImage V.ι).obj ((schemeOpenRestriction Y V).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ⟶ Q) (δ : Q ⟶ K⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧), Triangle.mk (adj.unit.app K) β δ ∈ distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory Y) ∧ schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y ((schemeDerivedDirectImage V.ι).obj ((schemeOpenRestriction Y V).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)) ∧ schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y Q ∧ (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : Y), x ∈ V → Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) n).obj Q).val.presheaf x))) ∧ ((∃ a : ℤ, K.IsGE a) → ∃ b : ℤ, Q.IsGE b)
